{{Otheruses|Taung}}
'''Taungsday''' was the name for the third [[Standard day/Legends|day]] of the [[Galactic Standard Calendar|Galactic Standard]] [[Standard week/Legends|week]] used on<ref name="Dining at Dex's">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> The day shared its name with the [[Taung/Legends|Taungs]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that once lived on Coruscant.<ref name="Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-2-ancient-coruscant|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 2 - Ancient Coruscant}}</ref> [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] located in Coruscant's [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] neighborhood, sold [[spicy Gargon gumbo]] for 1.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] as its daily [[Soup/Legends|soup]] on Taungsdays. On the same [[Local day/Legends|day]], the diner also sold a [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]]&ndash;style [[Shili cheese dog]] with a cup of soup for 5.5 credits and [[braised bruallki brisket]] for 8.7 credits as part of its lunch and dinner specials.<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Taungsday was created<ref name="Story Behind the Story">{{Blog|narbflick|11|Dining at Dex's: The Story Behind the Story}}</ref> for "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
